en: Black-and-white image showing a large stone suspension bridge with massive arched towers spanning a wide river. Ornamental lamps line the bridge, and people are walking across it. In the foreground there is a neatly landscaped riverside garden with paths, bushes, and several people strolling or tending plants. Across the river, a grand historic building with twin towers and a dome is visible. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century European cityscape. No visible printed text is present on the front.
